data.name: The Clown's Forest: Shadows of Blood
data.detailed_description:
The Clown's Forest: Shadows of Blood is a 2D Top-Down Psychological Horror game built in RPG Maker MZ, and is set during the events of The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows.

STORY:

Set during the events of The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows, join Officer Dragon as he is kidnapped by Chester, and taken to a very familiar location. Breaking out of a prison and avoiding Blitzo, Officer Dragon is forced to face a difficult decision, and face a past that has been haunting him for years. He isn't the only victim stuck in the forest though. Meet familiar, and unfamiliar faces as you fight to survive, or succumb to your death.

FEATURES:

  • Mind-bending and Heart breaking Story - The story is designed to bend your mind and tug at your heart strings. Blitzo will not hold back from tearing into Officer Dragon's mind.

  • Familiar Locations - Return to Hartown Manor one last time, as you dive deeper into Blitzo's actions from the first game.

  • Exploration - A lot of care has gone into making the world for this game, there is plenty of places to explore and try and find secrets

  • Collectibles - Secrets are hidden amongst the world, whether they be notes or dolls, they are dotted around for those who want an extra challenge

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100H or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 960 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 7.1
